import os,subprocess,time,ctypes
print(os.path.exists('/tmp/e2/void.so'))
s=open('/tmp/e2/v.cu').read()
s=s.replace('#if VOIDC\n','#ifndef VOIDC\n#define VOIDC 0\n#endif\n#if VOIDC\n',1)
open('/tmp/e2/v.cu','w').write(s)
V={'par':'', 'sc7':'-DCUSTOM=1 -DSC=7 -DSD=2 -DREUSE=1 -DDELAY=0',
   'nr4':'-DCUSTOM=1 -DSC=4 -DSD=2 -DREUSE=0 -DDELAY=0','nr7':'-DCUSTOM=1 -DSC=7 -DSD=2 -DREUSE=0 -DDELAY=0',
   'pf':'-DPF=1','dl4':'-DCUSTOM=1 -DSC=4 -DSD=2 -DREUSE=1 -DDELAY=1','pfsc7':'-DPF=1 -DCUSTOM=1 -DSC=7 -DSD=2 -DREUSE=1 -DDELAY=0',
   'e64':'-DEPN=64','e16':'-DEPN=16','pfnr4':'-DPF=1 -DCUSTOM=1 -DSC=4 -DSD=2 -DREUSE=0 -DDELAY=0'}
nv='/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc' if os.path.exists('/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc') else 'nvcc'
t=time.time(); P={}
for k,f in V.items():
    cmd=f"{nv} -O3 --use_fast_math -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC -I/usr/local/cutlass/include -I/usr/local/cutlass/tools/util/include {f} -o /tmp/e2/{k}.so /tmp/e2/v.cu"
    P[k]=subprocess.Popen(cmd,shell=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
for k,p in P.items():
    out=p.communicate()[0]
    if p.returncode: print(k,'FAIL',out[-1500:]); continue
    L=ctypes.CDLL(f'/tmp/e2/{k}.so'); o=(ctypes.c_int*8)(); L.info(o); print(k,list(o)[:7])
print('t',time.time()-t)
